notes.title: Brews & Bastards Launch and Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]Launch Day![/h1][p][/p][p]After almost 5 years of development, [i]Brews & Bastards[/i] has finally [b]launched![/b] We're very excited to finally let everybody enter the [i]Muneshine Tavern[/i] and descend into the corrupted brewery deep below. We can't wait to see everyone discover and use powerful brews against the hoards inebriated demons that are running rampant in the depths. [/p][p][/p][p]We've put a lot of booze, sweat and tears (and love!) into Brews & Bastards, but there are still lots of things we're working on that didn't make it into the 1.0 release! We don't want to leave these cool modes and items on the cutting room floor, so we've laid out a short roadmap for planned additional content in 2025 and beyond![/p][p][/p][h1]Roadmap![/h1][p][/p][p]Below is an image outlining the roadmap for Brews & Bastards going forward. If you want to know more or are interested in behind-the-scenes footage, join our Discord!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546721/afa2d8ec7f86d228d9517015688df3633e898d72.png"][/img][/p][p]Wow thrilling stuff. We're tired but happy for this launch, we'll be here watching and listening and working on all this cool stuff. 

Join the discussion and development behind-the-scenes on Discord [url="https://discord.gg/2vjFq3ZxBb"]HERE[/url]

Cheers,
-Erekose | Co-Creator. [/p]

notes.title: 🍺Brews & Bastards LAUNCH Stream!! 🍺
notes.content: [p]Brews & Bastards is out! Give it a whirl if ya like brews, bastards and twin stick shooters. You can even [b]play with your friends[/b] in co-op with [b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b] - they don't even need to own the game! It's pretty sick tbh.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning, there will more more content and updates to come. Join us in our [url="https://discord.gg/2vjFq3ZxBb"]Discord[/url] and for updates, memes, hell even suggest some new Brews we can add! See ya there 🍻[/p]

notes.title: Brews & Bastards - Game Overview
notes.content: [h1]🍻 BREWS & BASTARDS 🍻[/h1][h3]A STORY ABOUT SOME GLORIOUS BASTARDS AND A COUPLE O' BREWS[/h3][p][/p][p]As we draw nearer to the release of Brews & Bastards (final quarter 2025), we thought we'd shed some light on the game, like, "who are the Bastards?" and "what are the Brews?". Well, I think there's a bit of a Bastard in all of us, but more on that later. [/p][p][/p][p]Let's start with the story. The almighty Brew Stone, a powerful gem with infinite booze generating power, has been stolen. Snatched from the Brewstone Chalice which had so graciously replenished our heroes after a day of hard yakka. Who could have stolen the Brew Stone? The heroes must descend to the dungeons to find out who took it and, more importantly, retrieve the Brew Stone - god forbid they start sobering up. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546721/2739ee2f33af1486f6bebe5a0c75a9a1ecb04357.png"][/img][/p][p]The tale of our heroes is narrated by a charming little fellow from the tavern aptly named Martin Teeny🐁. Oh and there's a big handsome bartender, the "Beartender"🐻, who will keep you topped up with fresh brews on your journey.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546721/a764d60e0b942c8b9430724d1d95f457764f1248.png"][/img][/p][p][i](Left: The Beartender. Right: Martin Teeny \[colorised])[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]🍺PLAYABLE CHARACTERS (Bastards)🍺[/h2][p][/p][p]Remember how I said there's a bastard in all of us? Well some of us are good bastards (complementary) and some are bad bastards (derogatory). But let's start with our beloved Bastards - the four playable characters you can choose from before you descend to the dungeons below.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546721/30fb6eeef183feb720e5582becf6e56bf11da69f.png"][/img][/p][p]Each with their own unique styles and abilities, the playable characters are: [b]Rhine[/b] - the Rieslinger, [b]Oak[/b] - the Keggernaught, [b]Mugg[/b] - the Meadmancer, and last but not least, [b]Chugg[/b] - the Beerzerker.[/p][p]Try out each character in single player or see them all in action with up to 4 player local co-op![/p][p][/p][h2]👿ENEMIES (also Bastards)👿[/h2][p]Down in the dungeons you will have to fight waves of drunken Bastards (derogatory) - nasty amalgamations of crusty old booze and brewing equipment. Sentient kegs with misshapen legs and foul Jell-O Shots with minds of their own are common down in the depths.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546721/2a69a744202b297a63a403315a41b23c5c4fb2e4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]👹BIG BASTARDS (Bosses)👹[/h2][p]During your drunken mission, you'll butt heads with a bunch of Big Bastards, each with their own unique theme and gameplay mechanics. Sneak a lil' sip of this Big Bastard: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546721/28650d4d3386d4c57897c15d812b2adf8ca53935.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🍸Brews, Artifacts & Shards of the Brewstone 🍸[/h2][p][b]Brews[/b] are powerful abilities which you can wield to destroy the oncoming hordes of enemies. [b]Artifacts[/b] are passive items, buffing you and providing aid. Both can be attained from the [b]Beartender Shop[/b] for [i]ingredients [/i]or traded for at special monuments called [b]Wine Shrines[/b]. They can also be upgraded at [b]Cocktail Forges[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546721/ee072b4a4ec586b20135212e83ebdf013888394c.gif"][/img][/p][p][i](Our mate Mugg receives a newly upgraded, juicy brew from the Forge.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546721/1482941133c5055e876c0fd0b183a120e852b89d.png"][/img][/p][p][i](Left: Rhine contemplates a trade at the Wine Shrine. Right: Mugg is probably gonna buy that dank Bomb Shot Brew.)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]🧊 Brew Stone Shards 🧊[/h3][p]Brew stone shards are your classic, permanent player upgrade. You'll be given a random selection to choose from. Choose wisely... Or quickly snatch the one you want before your bastard "friend" sitting next to you all smug on the couch takes it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546721/66228a37d991e88db783e25421e2d7e03b595136.png"][/img][i](Two players, probably in a heated discussion, deciding which Shard to take.)[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]🍻 GRAB A BREW, GRAB A BASTARD 🍻[/h2][p]We will be announcing the release date for Brews & Bastards on [b]PC[/b] and [b]Xbox[/b] very soon! So make sure to keep an eye on our Steam posts, [b]wishlist[/b] the game if you haven't already or join our [b]Discord[/b] ([url="https://discord.com/invite/2vjFq3ZxBb"]https://discord.com/invite/2vjFq3ZxBb[/url]) for updates, beta participation and memes of course.[/p][p][/p][p]Most importantly: grab a brew, grab a mate (if you don't have a mate, just grab another brew) and get the bloody couch ready🍾! [i]Disclaimer: You could in-fact play at a desk too, even on a bus or public toilet if you have a Steam Deck, idk I'm not judging[/i] 🧐[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546721/39f6c7d8a228bed471f610a02c2f864d73ce8f57.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]See you Bastards soon![/p][p]- Hamish, Bastard Dev @ Mune Studio[/p]

notes.title: Brews & Bastards Next Fest Gameplay Stream
notes.content:
Brews & Bastards is a chaotic 1 to 4 player co-op dungeon crawler with an over-the-top fantasy tavern theme. Pick from a selection of class-based champions, each with their own distinct play styles and abilities, before traveling below the Muneshine Tavern and into a series of brewery themed dungeons that become more difficult and bizarre the further you descend.

Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/2vjFq3ZxBb]Brews & Bastards Discord[/url] channel to receive game updates, provide suggestions and feedback! 

Follow the [url=https://twitter.com/brewsnbastards]Brews & Bastards Twitter[/url] for development updates and behind the scenes content!
